beats.visual_focus: System architecture schematic illustrating RAPTOR highlighted in pulsing cyan.

beats.text: The core challenge? However. Most existing methods retrieve only short contiguous chunks from a retrieval corpus. Limiting holistic understanding of the overall document context.
beats.visual_focus: Bottleneck diagram showing resource contention and latency backup.

beats.text: Enter RAPTOR. Enter RAPTOR: Part 1 - The Context: the novel approach of recursively embedding. Clustering. And summarizing chunks of text. Constructing a tree with differing levels of summarization from the bottom up.
beats.visual_focus: Parallel pipeline splitting heavy operations away from the critical execution path.
